title: Documentation System — Where It Stands
thesis: Documentation is not a module in Softanza; it is a discipline built into how the library is made, and its signature is that the docs are run, not written, and the library can document itself. 134 literate narrations teach through stories whose every code-and-output block is produced by a real executed demo; the library answers Ask() / HowTo() / ExplainMethod() about its own API deterministically; 2,956 files carry inline #--> promises a harness checks; ~63 plans-of-record record what actually shipped. Where it is thin: no published doc site, no generated API reference, no measured coverage, and its own overview has drifted behind the system it describes.

lanes.note: 134 narrations where every code and output block is executed, paired with 17 *_narration_demo and 455 *_narrated guards; outputs are hand-pasted
stzSelfDoc/stzLibDoc answer Ask(), HowTo(), ExplainMethod() from source via a lexical-IDF retriever; deterministic, zero-hallucination; default corpus 2 classes
~63 design docs written before the code and amended as phases close, with STATUS/RESULTS banners recording files, guard count and narration per phase
2,956 files carry inline #--> promises; promises.py runs each file and walks them as an ordered subsequence; standalone, not in CI, tolerates stale promises
The harvester reads doc-comments above each def, lifts undocumented methods from #==# headers, inherits variants, synthesizes signatures; nothing emits a manual
quickers (22 + recipes), narrations (134), deepdives (8), references, faqs, internals (5) map onto Diataxis; references/ holds 3 files, faqs/ 1, misc/ 9 outside
22 quickers plus a recipes/ tree (list/number/string/text) with copy-ready one-liners, also ingested by the self-doc index; breadth limited to core types
8 deepdives plus design studies (SCOPE_ORIENTED_PROGRAMMING.md, SOFTANZA_ENGINE_ARCHITECTURE.md, *_VS_THE_FIELD.md); essay-driven, not systematically indexed
The library draws its own figures via stzCanvas/stzGraphCanvas/stzPlotCanvas/stzTreeCanvas; but they are committed PNGs nothing regenerates on a doc build
The reference is the live queryable self-doc plus a hand-written references/ of 3 files; no static, browsable, cross-linked API manual or generator
No measured doc coverage and prose freshness is unenforced: stz-doc-system-overview.md still describes 5 pillars while the tree has 9 surfaces
Hand-written markdown read on GitHub; no mkdocs.yml, conf.py, docusaurus.config.js or .rst anywhere; no site, no search, no versioned rendering

standouts: The docs are run, not written: 134 narrations whose every block is produced by an executed demo
The library documents itself: Ask() / HowTo() / ExplainMethod() are deterministic and zero-hallucination
Design docs that record what actually shipped, not just what was intended
Self-illustrating figures drawn by the thing being documented
gaps: A published doc site (MkDocs / Docusaurus over the existing markdown)
Generate the API reference from the stzReflectFuncs harvester
Refresh the system overview (5 pillars vs 9 surfaces) and widen the self-doc corpus beyond 2 classes
Measured doc coverage, and docs wired into CI
dated: Read from the source on 2026-09-17, from a read-only main worktree -- base/doc/narrations (134), base/meta/stzSelfDoc + stzLibDoc, base/reflect/stzReflectFuncs, base/meta/promises.py over 2,956 #--> files, base/doc/design (44) + SOFTANZA_*_PLAN.md, and stz-doc-system-overview.md
